scope: Corollary 6.4 of the manuscript “A singular normal affine surface with free tangent sheaf” (preprints/A-singular-normal-affine-surface-with-free-tangent-sheaf-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 048 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 48b1a74d3131e97b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Starting with the singular surface X = Spec A of Theorem 1.1, every iteration of blowing up at the derivation module is isomorphic to X. The same holds if each blowup is followed by normalization. Neither procedure resolves its singular point.
